data.name: Destination and/or Special Occasion Cruise
data.headline: 4 - 8 Hour Charters • Up to 6 People
data.description: Experience the beauty of Sarasota and its surrounding waters on a private yacht with an expert captain. Customize your 4, 6, or 8-hour tour to explore iconic landmarks, secluded islands, or waterfront attractions. Whether you want a relaxing day at the sandbar, a sunset cruise, dolphin watching, snorkeling, or a leisurely glide along the coast, your captain is there to ensure safety and fun. Relax, soak up the scenery, and create unforgettable memories tailored specifically to your preferences with a personalized itinerary or our captain's expert guidance.
data.highlights:
- Personalized tour tailored to your preferences
- Visit iconic and secluded locations
- Relaxing, scenic, and fun activities
- Experienced captain ensuring safety and enjoyment
data.itinerary:
1. Discuss preferences and destinations
2. Navigate to selected locations such as Egmont Key, Passage Key, Venice Island, Stump Pass, or Boca Grande
3. Enjoy activities like dolphin watching, snorkeling, or relaxing at the sandbar
4. Return with personalized experience tailored to your interests
data.what_is_included:
Knowledgeable and experienced captain
Private charter for your group
Customizable itinerary to suit your interests
what_is_included_items: Customizable itinerary to suit your interests
data.what_to_bring:
Swimwear and towels
Sun protection (sunscreen, hat, sunglasses)
Refillable water bottle
Camera or smartphone for photos
data.cancellation_notes: Customers will receive a full refund or credit with 24 hours notice of cancellation. Customers will also receive a full refund or credit in case of operator cancellation due to weather or other unforeseen circumstances. Contact us by phone to cancel or inquire about a cancellation. No-shows will be charged the full price
